source: Mail code of the core plugins (Pass Captain, Voucher Captain, Affiliate Captain, wp-license), read only
note: Event types not listed send no email in the core plugin. "to" is a recipient key; texts are English and translated by WorkflowCaptain\Admin\DataTexts.

pass.order.paid.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)
pass.order.paid.note: with PDF tickets; for WooCommerce orders also the order emails of WooCommerce

pass.order.tickets_issued.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)
pass.order.tickets_issued.note: the same email as for “Order paid”

pass.order.refunded.note: not for WooCommerce orders (WooCommerce sends those) and not for refunds in the payment provider’s dashboard

pass.refund.completed.note: with credit note; not for WooCommerce orders

pass.occurrence.rescheduled.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)

pass.occurrence.cancelled.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)

pass.event.cancelled.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)
pass.event.cancelled.note: for each affected date, also the cancellation of the date

voucher.order.vouchers_issued.off: can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails
can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails
can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails
voucher.order.vouchers_issued.note: for many codes; with a delivery date only at the time of delivery

voucher.voucher.issued_standalone.off: can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails
voucher.voucher.issued_standalone.note: only if “send” is chosen when issuing (default)

voucher.voucher.delivered.off: can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails, off by default
voucher.voucher.delivered.note: the voucher email itself was sent before this event

voucher.voucher.redeemed.off: can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails, off by default
voucher.voucher.redeemed.note: gifts only, only on the first redemption

affiliate.affiliate.created.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)
cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)
affiliate.affiliate.created.note: depending on the path: application, automatic approval or creation in the admin

affiliate.affiliate.status_changed.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)

affiliate.commission.created.off: setting notify_commissions (off by default) and the partner’s unsubscribe

affiliate.commission.created.note: only if the commission goes into review; later via cron

affiliate.commission.approved.off: setting notify_commissions (off by default) and the partner’s unsubscribe

affiliate.commission.rejected.off: setting notify_commissions (off by default) and the partner’s unsubscribe

affiliate.payout.cancelled.note: only if there was a credit note

affiliate.code_request.created.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)

affiliate.code_request.approved.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)

affiliate.code_request.rejected.off: cannot be turned off (only with a code filter)

license.license.issued.off: can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails
license.license.issued.note: also the order emails of WooCommerce

license.license.status_changed.off: can be turned off under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails
license.license.status_changed.note: depending on the change; reactivation without email
